VDA.e: Borrowed from German VDA (“German Association of the Automotive Industry”).

VDV.e: Borrowed from Russian ВДВ (VDV), acronym of Возду́шно-деса́нтные во́йска Росси́и (Vozdúšno-desántnyje vójska Rossíi, “Airborne landing force of Russia”).
